notes.title: Sonar Scout is available now!
notes.notes:
Hello divers!

Yesterday we officially released Sonar Scout!! Thank you to everyone who's already taken the time to play the game, leave reviews, and provide us with feedback and bug reports!

We've already uploaded a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3137740?updates=true&emclan=103582791474707291&emgid=516321579225842253]Day 1 Patch[/url] addressing a lot of minor issues you've been reporting, and over the next couple weeks we'll continue to fix any of the bugs you might find. Please join us on the Discord or use the Steam forums here to let us know what needs fixing.

Thank you again to everyone for supporting us. We're thrilled to see so many people already enjoying exploring and discovering all there is to find in Sonar Scout!

Happy diving :)

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Reworked "Shipwreck" level
[*] Cleaned up geometry across several levels
[*] Added small/large submarine silhouettes to levels where you can use all 3
[*] Fixed issue where collectables could make crystals glow
[*] Fixed issue where mouse would not reappear
[*] Improved controller menu navigation
[*] Fixed final color palette
[*] Swapped order of color palettes
[*] Toned down controller vibration
[*] Various other minor bug fixes
[/list]
